sections.heading: Planning your Lucerne Grand interior
sections.text:
Jurong is a large, well-equipped western region, and new condominium owners here often plan the first fit-out as a family home for the long stretch: school bags, bulk groceries, guests, and a living room that has to work on ordinary weeknights. The carpentry that typically supports that life is an entry shoe and drop cabinet, a living-room joinery wall, full-height wardrobes, and a fitted kitchen with a tall pantry rather than a row of loose cabinets. A common bedroom is often asked to be a study or a child’s room; a built-in desk and wardrobe along one wall keeps the floor clear. Maison is an interior designer. We specify built-in carpentry, finished professionally, not IKEA-style furniture, and we will design from your approved plan only.

No official floor plan is on file, so typologies and room sizes are not published here, and we will not guess a “typical Jurong condo layout”. Lakeside View, already live on this site, is a nearby HDB page in Jurong West; it is a useful internal link for readers in the same region, not a typologies reference for Lucerne Grand. We will not invent walking times to a lake, to Jurong East, or to any MRT station. Check facing, afternoon sun and the management handbook before you decide on blinds, a balcony cabinet or a window bench.

When you have a key date in writing, plan backwards from it: defects, measurement, renovation approval, then fabrication lead time. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals, as an editorial allowance only. WhatsApp Maison with your plan and unit type. We are not affiliated with the developer.
